selection: Exact original 130-file manifest plus its manifest and verification receipt, new packaging documentation, reproducible verifier and byte-integrity report. No recursive workspace/home inclusion.
technical_metadata_policy: Search records retain relevant source/archive/member names, sizes, hashes, exclusions and bounded code excerpts to make coverage reproducible. Mentioning a previously excluded cache path does not include its payload.
limitations: Signature and path screening are bounded checks, not a proof that all possible secrets are detectable.
